meta.title: Content Workbench
meta.description: Turns one article into a long-form web page, a Xiaohongshu card set and a WeChat cover pair, optionally plus a vertical Douyin video. The skill appears in every Session and a “Content Workbench” entry appears in the left sidebar (can be turned off in the plugin configuration); it opens a new Session with a draft instruction that names the multichannel-story skill, and the skill self-checks dependencies first.
